title: Authentic Bidriware Metal Craft Authenticator
problem: Cheap painted tin items trick tourists in town into thinking they are buying genuine silver-inlaid Bidriware metal art from local artisans.
idea: A checker that looks at the item and gives clues: is it real silver inlay on black metal, or just paint? Try it, then learn the facts in the quiz.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What does the camera see on the item?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine compares photos of real Bidri work and painted copies. Tap what you see. (This only gives clues — the best proof is buying from a trusted seller.)
widgets.question: Looking closely, the item has:

options.label: Silver lines set into deep black metal
options.result: Looks like real Bidri inlay. The silver is set into the metal, not painted on top.
options.te: అసలైన బిద్రీలా ఉంది. వెండి లోహంలో పొదిగారు, పైన పూయలేదు.

options.label: Shiny paint that sits on top
options.result: Looks painted. Real Bidri has silver inlaid, not silver paint.
options.te: పెయింట్ వేసినట్టుంది. అసలైన బిద్రీలో వెండి పొదుగుతారు.

options.label: Very light and thin, like a tin can
options.result: Too light. Real Bidri is a solid cast alloy and feels heavier.
options.te: చాలా తేలికగా ఉంది. అసలైన బిద్రీ బరువుగా ఉంటుంది.

options.label: GI tag / government emporium bill
options.result: Good sign! Buy from government handicraft showrooms or known artisans.
options.te: మంచి సంకేతం! ప్రభుత్వ హస్తకళల దుకాణాలు లేదా తెలిసిన కళాకారుల దగ్గర కొనండి.

items.title: Born in Bidar
items.text: Bidriware started in Bidar (now in Karnataka), and is famous across the Hyderabad region.
items.te: బిద్రీ కళ బీదర్‌లో పుట్టింది, హైదరాబాద్ ప్రాంతంలో ప్రసిద్ధి.

items.title: Special metal
items.text: Items are cast from an alloy of zinc and a little copper.
items.te: జింక్, కొంచెం రాగి కలిపిన లోహంతో పోత పోస్తారు.

items.title: Silver inlay
items.text: Artists carve fine designs and hammer pure silver wire or sheet into them.
items.te: చక్కటి డిజైన్ చెక్కి అందులో వెండిని పొదుగుతారు.

items.title: Black with soil
items.text: The item is blackened using a special soil paste, so the silver shines brightly.
items.te: ప్రత్యేక మట్టి పేస్ట్‌తో నల్లగా చేస్తారు, వెండి మెరుస్తుంది.

questions.why: The craft is named after Bidar.

questions.q: What metal is inlaid in real Bidriware?
questions.why: Real Bidri has silver (sometimes brass) inlaid into the black metal.

questions.q: How is the metal made black?
questions.why: A paste of special soil is used to darken the alloy.

questions.q: Where is the safest place to buy real Bidriware?
options: Government handicraft showrooms or known artisans
questions.why: Trusted sellers help make sure the money reaches real artisans.

how: Ask a Bidri artisan or a government handicraft showroom for permission to photograph real pieces.
Collect photos of painted copies too (from shop windows or the internet, for learning only).
In Teachable Machine, make classes: Real inlay, Painted copy. Use close-up photos (about 40 each).
Train, Export and open the model in PictoBlox with the Machine Learning extension.
Show a green 'Looks real – check the seller' or orange 'Looks painted – be careful' message. Never say 100% sure.
Ask Gemini to write simple buyer tips in English and Telugu for tourists.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. In simple English and Telugu, explain how Bidriware is made and give 4 easy clues tourists can use to tell real silver-inlaid Bidriware from painted copies. Remind them to buy from trusted sellers.
